summary: All five criteria are met on their own wording and the tests pass (npm test 116/116, npm run check 11/11, tests/bash-prose.test.mjs 9/9). The block is a guard regression: the run-later exemption in isRunLater is case-sensitive and only recognises a bare or ./-prefixed file name, so on this case-insensitive darwin filesystem a heredoc written to one spelling and run under another, or run by an absolute or parent path, is dropped from the judged text and a git reset --hard passes. That breaks the exception the docs/rules.md row promises, and the same command was denied before this change.

findings.issue: isRunLater compares the written file name case-sensitively and only against bare or ./-prefixed paths, so a heredoc written as RUN.sh and run as run.sh, or run through an absolute or parent path, has its body dropped and a denied git reset --hard passes, contrary to the rules.md row's stated exception that a later-run file stays scanned.
findings.suggestion: Match the run-later name case-insensitively and accept any path whose final segment equals the written file name, or keep the body whenever the file's basename appears as an argument after a shell word in the tail.
